view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse aisle with tall metal shelving units stocked with boxes on wooden pallets. The floor is concrete, and the space extends into the distance. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the area. A forklift is visible in the far background near another aisle. Yellow protective bumpers are attached to some shelves.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall black metal shelving units line the left side of the aisle, extending into the background. They hold stacked boxes and are supported by vertical posts. Some shelves have yellow protective bumpers attached. The structure is integrated into the warehouse ceiling framework.

objects.label: stacked white boxes
objects.observation: White boxes with yellow bands are stacked vertically on wooden pallets along the aisle. They are positioned directly under the shelves and appear to be secured to the pallets. The stack is aligned with the shelving unit.

objects.label: red boxes
objects.observation: Bright red boxes with green circular logos are arranged on a wooden pallet in the foreground. They are placed at the base of the shelving unit and are fully visible. The boxes are stacked neatly and rest on the pallet surface.

objects.label: yellow protective bumper
objects.observation: A tall, rectangular yellow bumper is mounted vertically on the side of a shelf post. It is positioned between the shelf and the aisle floor. The bumper appears to be affixed to the post and serves as a safety barrier.

objects.label: wooden pallet
objects.observation: A light-colored wooden pallet is visible in the foreground, supporting the red boxes. It has slatted construction and rests directly on the concrete floor. Another pallet is visible further down the aisle holding white boxes.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: A gray forklift is visible in the distant background, parked near the end of the aisle. It is partially obscured by shelves and boxes. The vehicle is stationary and appears to be facing away from the camera.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The warehouse floor is smooth, light gray concrete that stretches across the entire frame. It reflects overhead lights and shows faint marks from equipment movement. The floor provides a flat surface for pallets and vehicles.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-31857", "image_size": [1280, 800], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
